summary: First-pass end-to-end testing of Madam Boutique Module 1. Backend: 15/15 pytest cases pass (health, content, pincode, login/me/logout, invalid password, lockout after 5, full email registration flow, token reuse, re-register 409, weak-password, bad-category, forgot+reset+reuse-token, profile update, unauth /me). Frontend: home renders all data-testids at 1920/1024, nav-contact scrolls, contact links use tel:/wa.me/mailto:, Phase-2 placeholders render, mobile menu opens with links & login button. Login (valid+invalid), session persistence over reload, logout, guest->/account redirect+login->/account, header-account-button text 'My Account', Google button navigates to https://auth.emergentagent.com/oauth/?redirect=<origin>/account (matches spec). Signup flow: existing email 409 message, verification-sent + dev link, /signup?token= loads details form with locked email disabled, PIN 700055 auto-fills state West Bengal (city auto-fills 'North 24 Parganas' - India Post district), password mismatch error, successful signup redirects to /account with new profile name. Invalid token shows signup-verification-invalid + request-new-link (logged-out state). Account edit: profile-edit-button -> profile-form -> save -> profile-details reflects Howrah. Forgot-password: sent + reset link; /reset-password with no token shows reset-missing-token; weak password shows reset-error; valid reset redirects to /login with toast.

critical.issue: dev_link (and email link) uses the internal cluster host 'https://madam-home-login.cluster-5.preview.emergentcf.cloud/...' instead of the public REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL / FRONTEND_URL. That host returns 403 Forbidden externally, so verification/reset links from emails are unusable. request_origin() in auth/router.py prefers request.headers.get('origin'), which the ingress overrides with the internal cluster host. Fix: prefer settings.FRONTEND_URL when set (or trust only Origin header values matching an allow-list). Confirmed via curl -H 'Origin: https://elegance-auth-1.preview.emergentagent.com' still returning cluster-5 URL.

minor.issue: Login error body uses FastAPI default shape {"detail": "..."}; frontend maps it correctly, but the spec text 'Invalid email or password' is only in detail (fine).

ui_bugs.issue: Horizontal scroll present at 390px viewport (documentElement.scrollWidth > clientWidth). Something inside the home page overflows on mobile.

integration_issues.flow: Email verification & password reset via dev_link
integration_issues.issue: dev_link returned by API is a cluster-internal URL and cannot be opened by the user; workaround in tests is to rewrite the host to the public URL. This will also break real emails once Resend is enabled.

action_items: Backend: fix link generation so verification/reset URLs always use the public frontend URL (prefer settings.FRONTEND_URL over request Origin header, or validate Origin against an allow-list). This is a blocker for email delivery.
Frontend: eliminate horizontal scroll on home page at 390px viewport (inspect hero/lob cards/contact section for overflow; likely an image or wide element).
critical_code_review_comments: auth/router.py request_origin(): trusting unvalidated Origin header for outbound links is risky (open-redirect-like via emails). Use FRONTEND_URL from env as source of truth.
Login/Signup Google buttons: onClick handler uses window.location.href navigation; no href attribute so keyboard/accessibility users can't middle-click. Acceptable but worth noting.

Cookie set with SameSite=None; Secure=True — good for cross-site frontend/backend. Ensure CORS_ORIGINS is not '*' in production when credentials are used (currently CORS_ORIGINS=*; if FastAPI CORSMiddleware allow_credentials=True with '*' origin, browsers reject; verify this works in prod).

success_rate.frontend: ~92% (all flows work except dev_link host and 390px horizontal scroll)

test_credentials: test.customer@madamboutique.in / Madam@1234 (seed). New QA users created dynamically with qa.<ts>@example.org; some were password-reset to New@12345.
seed_data_creation: Several transient users created via /api/auth/register (qa.<timestamp>@example.org) during tests. Not cleaned up automatically; consider a teardown that drops all users with email prefix 'qa.' from the users collection.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest is at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (pytest -v). It expects the seeded user test.customer@madamboutique.in / Madam@1234. The two failing E2E aspects are: (1) dev_link host = cluster-5 internal URL (not opening externally); (2) horizontal scroll at 390px on home. All other data-testids from the spec are present and working. Google auth button correctly redirects to https://auth.emergentagent.com/oauth/?redirect=<origin>/account.
rca of the issue: dev_link uses internal host because request_origin() in auth/router.py prefers request.headers['origin'] over settings.FRONTEND_URL. The K8s ingress rewrites the Origin header of incoming requests to the internal cluster hostname (cluster-5.preview.emergentcf.cloud), so the backend receives the wrong Origin. Fix by using settings.FRONTEND_URL when configured (already available in backend/.env), e.g.: return settings.FRONTEND_URL or request.headers.get('origin') or str(request.base_url).rstrip('/'). This will also protect against open-redirect vectors in production emails.
